criteria: Not present in this note at all
Barely present - mentioned once, in passing
Present strongly - the note dwells on it
Dominant - the note is largely about this
question.instructions: How strongly does the note use superlative or highly positive evaluative language (e.g., 'gorgeous', 'amazing', 'great success', 'seamless', 'beautiful') to praise the wine overall?

standard_answer.note:
原因是这段酒评整体是正面的，但并没有使用很强烈的赞美词，例如 gorgeous、amazing、beautiful、great success。
最明显的正面评价是：
“The structure and the richness are just right”

其中 “just right” 是明确的赞美，但强度比较温和。dense, complex structure 也偏正面，但更多是在描述酒的结构特征，而不是强烈夸赞。
因此最合适的是：Barely present，而不是 Present strongly 或 Dominant。
